messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — People Ops is launching a Central Talent Pool and short-term rotation program to support Q2 scaling of Dedicated & Runtime teams. This is an opt-in internal mobility path for engineers, PMs, and infra SREs. Details below. :loudspeaker:

Maya Patel: Why — we need flexible coverage for 6–12 week rotations to accelerate capacity/runtimes onboarding without external hires delaying milestones. Rotations are paid, no change to compensation, and you keep your original manager during the move.

Maya Patel: Timeline: application window opens today, closes in 7 calendar days. Rotations start as early as May 4th. Backfill approvals will be fast-tracked (people-ops + hiring managers).

Carlos Nguyen: +1 this is critical for Dedicated rollout. Managers: please flag roles you can temporarily spare or need urgent coverage. cc @Priya Natarajan and @Jia Wang

Priya Natarajan: For runtime: we'll prioritize people with CUDA / serving experience. We can provide onboarding docs and 2-week shadowing. Also firewall access will be provisioned by infra team — drop me a DM with names.

Jia Wang: SRE note — rotations onto oncall teams require a 3-day shadow + runbook pass. We'll pair new folks with a buddy. If you plan to rotate, please confirm you're okay with oncall shifts.

Evan Carter: Hiring ops: we'll convert some roles to 3-month temp IC contractors where rotation isn't possible. Recruiters will post those today.

Lina Chavez: Folks — application form: https://redwood.internal/talent-pool (use your company email). People Ops will triage and share matches within 5 business days.

RecruitingBot: :white_check_mark: Application received for Maya Patel (test entry). Current queue length: 0.

Maya Patel: FAQs: 1) Compensation — unchanged. 2) Performance reviews — remain with home manager. 3) Permanent moves — possible after rotations, but require manager sign-off. 4) Training stipend — $500 for hardware access/setup.

Carlos Nguyen: Managers, please review this week so we can keep momentum. If you have constraints (e.g., HIPAA customers), mark on the form.

Priya Natarajan: I'll host a 30-min Q&A tomorrow 11:00am PT in #people-ops for technical questions — invite sent.

Jia Wang: Assigning buddies — please include preferred buddy names in the form if you have them.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — ping me or @Lina Chavez for edge cases. :pray:
